entities.name: Fall of Constantinople
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Ottoman conquest of Constantinople on 29 May 1453, ending the Byzantine Empire (the last remnant of Rome) after 1,100 years. Scholars fleeing to Italy catalyzed the Renaissance; Ottoman control of trade routes spurred the Age of Exploration.
